items.title: SDK downloads, 1 to 23 October (PyPI + npm)
items.body: REAL public data, pulled 24 Oct 2026 from pypistats.org (without mirrors) and api.npmjs.org. livekit-plugins-reson8 on PyPI: 3,941 (September: 4,929). @reson8-labs/agents-plugin-reson8 on npm: 26,794 (September: 16,639). Total 30,735 in 23 days, against 21,568 in all of September. Downloads include CI installs, so they track developer adoption, not users.

facts.text: SDK downloads hit 30.7k in 1 to 23 October (PyPI + npm), already past September's 21.6k
